flags.description: The meal plan: the bottom tabs (Recipes, Week, Groceries, Pantry) and the recipe screen's Add to plan and Add to groceries.
Chef mode: the Settings switch (Steps section) for short steps written on the device, shown in the reading view and cook mode.
Ingredient amounts inside steps: Settings' Steps section and its 'Amounts in steps' switch (off by default), which puts each line's amount, as scaled and converted, where a step names the ingredient.
The free tier: 20 recipes, a one-time unlock for unlimited, the Settings row to buy or restore it and the Recipes count. Off until the store products exist.

A recipe picked from the page's text by the on-device model when the page has no JSON-LD or microdata recipe: every line kept is checked to be on the page, and the reading view says so. Unsupported phones and languages behave as before.

Typed decisions by the on-device model where the rules give up: whether a count's bracket is the total or each item's (scaling), whether a close pantry name is the same ingredient (Have/Buy), and the aisle of an item the keyword table puts in Other. Only a definite answer given twice with high confidence acts; unsupported phones and languages behave as before.
